name: everyware
description: Everyware website monorepo: React/Vite marketing app, Astro blog, and SEO tooling.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/site && npm run build -w apps/blog && node scripts/merge-dist.mjs && npm run seo:audit -- --dist dist --format json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json && npm run astro-check -w apps/blog
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
